read_reason: Check whether the Playwright race linked from the selectionchange issue exposes broader editor e2e harness pressure.
takeaway: Lexical saw multiple clipboard/selection/navigation e2e failures after Playwright 1.54.x; maintainers characterized it as internal test timing and later reported no problem on newer Playwright.
Lexical uses a process-wide clipboard lock and direct clipboard event capture helpers.

read_reason: Check selection/copy/paste assertion behavior around flaky Playwright timing.
takeaway: Lexical has explicit selection assertions plus synthetic clipboard paste fallback, but the issue shows helpers still depended on Playwright timing enough to fail across versions.

read_reason: Read failing copy/paste test families from the issue.
takeaway: Failures are copy/paste after select-all, heading selection, and inline paste; these are proof-harness timing risks, not a Slate runtime signal by themselves.

read_reason: Map Lexical timing lesson to Slate proof API.
takeaway: Slate has an exclusive clipboard lock and native clipboard write helpers.
